faq.gotQuestionsWeGotAnswers: Got questions? We got answers! (Probably. We're a demo site, so don't hold us to it. 🚴)
faq.howLongDoesShippingTakeAnswer: Great news: this is a demo site, so shipping is instant! Orders automatically progress through Confirmed → Processing → Shipped → Delivered at warp speed. You won't actually receive anything (sorry, no real bikes 😢), but you WILL get a pretend invoice via email — and that email is genuinely real, sent via Azure Communication Services. Think of it as the world's fastest online shopping experience, with actual email infrastructure. 🚀📧
faq.doYouOfferFreeShippingAnswer: Absolutely! We offer 100% free shipping on absolutely everything, because shipping imaginary bikes costs nothing. Standard, expedited, overnight — all free, all fictitious. Our warehouse is a SQL database and our delivery driver is a scheduled job. 📦
faq.canIChangeOrCancelMyOrder: Can I change or cancel my order?
faq.canIChangeOrCancelMyOrderAnswer: You can place as many orders as your heart desires and cancel them all with equal enthusiasm — this is a demo after all! Orders will automatically progress through the fulfilment pipeline regardless. Think of each order as a little Azure adventure that costs you absolutely nothing. ☁️
faq.howDoITrackMyOrder: How do I track my order?
faq.howDoITrackMyOrderAnswer: Your order will automatically move through all the stages — Confirmed, Processing, Shipped, Out for Delivery, Delivered — without any intervention required from you or anyone else. You can watch the progress on the Order Tracking page. It's deeply satisfying and completely fake. 🎉
faq.whatIsYourReturnPolicyAnswer: Our return policy is extremely generous: you never actually receive anything, so there's nothing to return! But if you do somehow manage to return something to us, we'll be incredibly impressed and possibly frightened. 🤔
faq.howDoIStartAReturn: How do I start a return?
faq.howDoIStartAReturnAnswer: Since no real products are ever dispatched, returns are spiritually supported but logistically unnecessary. That said, if you'd like to roleplay a return, the support email address on this page will happily receive your pretend return request. We'll pretend to process it. 📮
faq.whenWillIReceiveMyRefund: When will I receive my refund?
faq.whenWillIReceiveMyRefundAnswer: Refunds arrive in exactly the same timeframe as the original charge: never, because no real money changes hands! Your payment information is accepted and then respectfully ignored. Think of it as financial theatre. 🎭
faq.canIExchangeAnItemForDifferentSize: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
faq.canIExchangeAnItemForDifferentSizeAnswer: Yes! Simply place a new order in the size you want. Since nothing is real and everything is free, you can order every size simultaneously and live your best demo-site life. We support XS through XXL and everything in between. 🚴‍♀️🚴🚴‍♂️
faq.howDoIChooseRightBikeSize: How do I choose the right bike size?
faq.howDoIChooseRightBikeSizeAnswer: Bike sizing depends on your height and inseam length. Generally: 5'0"–5'4" = XS/S, 5'4"–5'8" = S/M, 5'8"–6'0" = M/L, 6'0"–6'4" = L/XL. That said, since these bikes are digital, they fit everyone perfectly. We've solved cycling ergonomics. You're welcome. 🏆
faq.areYourBikesFullyAssembledAnswer: Our bikes are 100% assembled as JPEG images and database records. No hex keys required. No confusing instruction diagrams. No leftover screws of mysterious origin. Just pure, effortless digital cycling. 🔧 (P.S. — this is a demo site, in case you hadn't gathered.)
faq.doYouOfferAWarrantyAnswer: We offer an infinite warranty on all our products, because nothing ever breaks when it doesn't exist. Your digital bike will remain in pristine condition forever, safely stored in our Azure SQL database, blissfully unaffected by weather, road conditions, or rogue shopping trolleys. 🛡️
faq.whatIfAnItemIsOutOfStock: What if an item is out of stock?
faq.whatIfAnItemIsOutOfStockAnswer: Our stock levels are maintained in the database and items can show as out of stock. If something you want is unavailable, check back later — or browse the many other fine imaginary products we have in stock right now. Everything is equally undeliverable, so it's a perfectly level playing field. ⚖️
faq.whatPaymentMethodsDoYouAccept: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.whatPaymentMethodsDoYouAcceptAnswer: We accept fake credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover — all equally pretend), and Not-Really-PayPal (it won't redirect anywhere; that would be rude). No real money is ever charged — ever. We also support a wide range of currencies! The currency shown is automatically determined by the region of your delivery address, so if you ship to Germany you'll see Euros, Japan gets Yen, and so on. It's one of the cooler features of this demo. 💱
faq.isMyPaymentInformationSecureAnswer: Your card details are validated for format (we check if the number passes the Luhn algorithm, just for fun) but are never actually stored, charged, or transmitted to any payment processor. It's about as secure as a payment can be — because it doesn't do anything. 🔒 (The rest of the site uses proper Azure security, Managed Identity, and zero connection strings in code. The devs are very proud of this.)
faq.doINeedAnAccountToPlaceOrder: Do I need an account to place an order?
faq.doINeedAnAccountToPlaceOrderAnswer: You can browse and explore without an account, but signing up unlocks the full demo experience: order history, wishlists, saved addresses, saved payment methods, and the ability to watch your pretend orders progress through the fulfilment pipeline. It's worth it just for the journey. ✨
faq.howDoIResetMyPassword: How do I reset my password?
faq.howDoIResetMyPasswordAnswer: Password management lives on your Account page. You can change your password there, and there are no password restrictions — this is a demo, so '1' is a perfectly valid password (though we'll quietly judge you). Passwords are hashed before storage, so we never know what yours is. Which is reassuring, or concerning, depending on how you feel about '1' as a password. 🔑

faq.availableHours: Imaginary support hours: 24/7, including bank holidays, Christmas, and the heat death of the universe.
